title: agrimonia pubescens var. microcarpa
intro: Agrimonia pubescens var. microcarpa, commonly known as small-fruited Agrimony, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Agrimonia pubescens var. microcarpa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiarrheal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and coumarins. The bioactive constituents in Agrimonia pubescens var. microcarpa are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable plant in natural medicine.
